purpose: Metadata-only clarification for conditional NAGALA admission before any scientific target evaluation
allowed_return: provenance, download bytes, file hashes and version
sheet names, row/column counts and original header names
units and category coding explicitly stated in headers, metadata or original methods
one-row-per-person or longitudinal structure if documented
original study eligibility and measurement methods with locators
unresolved semantic fields without inference from participant values
forbidden_return: means, standard deviations, quantiles or value ranges
category frequencies, event totals or outcome frequencies
correlations, fitted models, coefficients or endpoint analysis
original target-study result tables as construction evidence
analytical_use_under_consideration: Baseline whole-cohort age/sex/BMI/fasting-glucose generation from independent external evidence; final variables and three estimands not frozen
paper_note: Original Okamura paper is already counted once by admission reviewer; only its methods may be further inspected. No new source study search.
uncertainty_note: Complete clinical metadata does not make finite cohort statistics population truth. No inference or confidence intervals are produced at this step.
